en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a landscaped circular park in the foreground, benches, gas lamps, and several people sitting or standing. At the center stands a cylindrical monument or fountain with reliefs and a large statue of a figure on top, encircled by an iron fence. Behind it is a row of 3‑story gabled houses with shopfronts at street level, and in the background rises a church tower with a tall, narrow spire. Some German shop signs are visible on the buildings.
